scope: Current installed source/report supplement; exact Node own-member inventory, conservative per-member evidence. Not full Node/Web Streams parity or a performance claim.

statuses.supported: Specified finite binding/introspection contract or recorded fields only.
statuses.partial: Implemented/reused with a bounded tested subset and explicit deviations; not all overloads.
statuses.import-only: Binding imports/inspects safely, callable operation remains explicitly deferred.
statuses.deferred: Selected operation not supplied; stated callable refusals or future planned work only.
statuses.unavailable: Observable selected property is absent; ordinary read is undefined, with future work tracked separately.
statuses.unverified: Target member presence and behavior are not established; it may be absent or may execute. No refusal promise.

capabilityPolicy: Pure stream semantics select no host interface; underlying user sources/sinks or HTTP/FS adapters may require separately explicitly selected standard WASI capabilities.

notes: Earlier retained native constructor gate observed missing Node illegal/invalid constructor codes and TransformStreamDefaultController.length1 vsNode0. Fresh v9 verifies real constructor identity; constructor metadata beyond recorded v9 fields remains unverified.

methodology.inventory: Exact18 Node ESM names and exact own string static/prototype members checked against preserved Node inventory; own symbol descriptors added by side-effect-free Node22 reflection. Getter values/constructors are never invoked by this generator.
methodology.currentVsHistorical: Historical11-case and constructor probes remain separate. pipeTo/tee/strategy/backpressure observations there do not become fresh installed v9 parity.
methodology.helperFlag: The reused policy subreport ordinaryNativeBrandProof:false is historical helper labeling, not used as the native integration proof. Actual installed provenance uses exact compiled kernel, public API source, no bundled factory/registry, real/spoof/proxy guard cases and actual identities.
methodology.inheritedMembers: Own-member inventory does not enumerate arbitrary Function/Object ancestors. Unlisted/inherited members are unverified, possibly absent or executable, never automatically denied. Returned iterator semantic rows are operation descriptions, not new ESM members. Nonregistry private Symbol descriptions are reflection labels, not portable keys/public API requirements.
methodology.limits: Caps bound individual accepted inputs/views; not application retained queues, lifetime output, outstanding promise calls or generic native allocation failure.
methodology.noPerformanceClaim: Components contain test corpora; sizes are provenance only. No throughput, minimal deployment size or memory result inferred.
methodology.archiveRelationship: Separate supplementary evidence after accepted immutable foundations-v9; original accepted archive is not modified.
